# units/tb

> n tb: terabytes: 1000 gb, as bytes.

truck [units](../units.md) · [source](../../../registry/units/tb.pkg)

```
print 3 tb   // 3000000000000
```

Binds tighter than any operator, so `2 * 3 tb` is `2 * (3 tb)`.
See [units](../units.md).

## Syntax

Kind: `postfix`, precedence 90, left-associative

```
{n: expr int} tb -> int
```

| slot | takes | type |
|---|---|---|
| `n` | expression | `int` |

Produces: `int`

## Expands to
